Package com.stockroom.persistence

Class CsvInventoryRepository

java.lang.Object
com.stockroom.persistence.CsvInventoryRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
InventoryRepository
public class CsvInventoryRepository extends Object implements InventoryRepository
Stores the inventory in a UTF-8 CSV file, data/inventory.csv by default.

File layout:

 # next-id: 8
 id,name,quantity,threshold
 1,Hex Bolts,25,5
 2,"Nuts, hex",3,5
 3,"6"" Ruler",0,2

Fields containing a comma, a double quote or a line break are wrapped in double quotes, and quotes inside them are doubled (RFC 4180). Lines starting with # are comments; the next-id comment keeps deleted IDs from being reused after a restart.

Loading is forgiving: a line with the wrong number of fields, a non-numeric number or a blank name is skipped, and the rest of the file is still loaded. Range and duplicate checks are left to the inventory manager. Saving writes a temporary file first and then moves it over the real one, so a failed save never leaves a half-written file.

    • parseRecords

      static List<List<String>> parseRecords(String content)
      Splits CSV text into records of fields, following RFC 4180 quoting. Quoted fields may contain commas, doubled quotes and line breaks. Blank lines are dropped.

      Returns:
